comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body:
Done. The mirror holds a Layout per tab; muster-herdr rebuilds the tree
from layout_updated's rectangles by exact containment and keeps the
ratio off the border rather than dividing the rects. Cases in
corpus/conformance/layout-reconstruction.json, all expectations derived
from herdr's own layout.export rather than from our output.

Two findings worth carrying forward:

The subscription was never asking for layout.updated. Every offline
test passed - recorded bytes cannot show a subscription that was never
opened - so a live daemon would have rendered the tree it had at
connect and frozen it. Caught by the one daemon-backed test added here,
which is the argument for having it.

A reconstruction taking any first-child candidate rather than the
largest is wrong only when a split nests under a first child along its
own axis. Nothing recorded had that shape, so the implementation was
broken deliberately, the corpus passed, and the probe now records
columns(columns(p3, p6), p4) as well.

Left for the seam landing: nothing in the shell can see any of this
yet, and Change::LayoutChanged has no consumer.

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
The mirror knows a pane's tab and workspace and nothing about where it
sits, so there is no tree for a window to render. This is the noun that
is missing.

`layout_updated` is the source: it carries a whole tab's layout in
absolute values, so applying it twice is applying it once, and it fires
on every pane event (observations/herdr-0.8.0.md). What it does not
fire for is tab and workspace events, so it must not become the only
structural signal.

The catch is that its rects live in herdr's own TUI coordinate space -
the recorded area is 54x23 at (26,1), herdr's window minus its sidebar.
Only structure and ratios mean anything to Muster; the cell numbers are
for reconstructing which node contains which, and nothing else. A tree
rebuilt that way is also how a divider is named back to the daemon,
since `layout.set_split_ratio` addresses one by a path of booleans.

Blocked on a_27RZE8ywI: a reconstruction checked against the one
recorded layout is a reconstruction checked against nothing.
title: 🧱 Layout in the vocabulary: a tab's tree, in Muster's words
